description: Add HACS support files and installation instructions. Create hacs.json configuration, a README.md with HACS and manual installation instructions, and update manifest.json codeowners.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth/hacs.json in the repository root with the following fields: name ('TCL Home Soundbar'), hacs content_in_root set to false, render_readme set to true, and zip_release set to false. This is the HACS configuration file that tells HACS how to install the integration.

Update /projects/sandbox/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth/custom_components/tcl_soundbar/manifest.json: (a) set codeowners to ["@benbridts"], (b) change the name from 'TCL Soundbar' to 'TCL Home Soundbar' to make it generic enough to cover any TCL soundbar that uses the TCL Home app via Bluetooth.

Create /projects/sandbox/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth/README.md with: a title 'TCL Home Soundbar' and brief description explaining this is a Home Assistant custom integration for controlling TCL soundbars that use the TCL Home app via Bluetooth LE. Include a features section mentioning power on/off, volume control, mute, and source selection. Include a Prerequisites section noting a Bluetooth adapter is required on the HA host. Include an Installation section with two subsections: (1) HACS installation (add as custom repository with URL https://github.com/benbridts/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth, category Integration, then install) and (2) Manual installation (copy custom_components/tcl_soundbar to the HA config/custom_components/ directory). Include a Configuration section noting the integration auto-discovers TCL soundbars via Bluetooth or can be added manually via Settings > Integrations. Include a Supported Devices section listing known compatible devices (TCL S55HE Soundbar) and noting that other TCL soundbars compatible with the TCL Home app should also work.
acceptance_criteria: hacs.json exists at the repository root and is valid JSON with correct fields
manifest.json codeowners field is ["@benbridts"] and name is 'TCL Home Soundbar'
README.md exists at the repository root with HACS installation instructions including the custom repository URL
README.md includes manual installation instructions as an alternative
verification: Run: python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/projects/sandbox/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth/hacs.json'))" to validate hacs.json is valid JSON

Run: python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('/projects/sandbox/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth/custom_components/tcl_soundbar/manifest.json')); assert m['codeowners'] == ['@benbridts'], f'Got {m[chr(99)+chr(111)+chr(100)+chr(101)+chr(111)+chr(119)+chr(110)+chr(101)+chr(114)+chr(115)]}'" to verify codeowners
Run: test -f /projects/sandbox/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth/README.md && echo 'README exists' to confirm README was created
Run: grep -q 'HACS' /projects/sandbox/ha-tcl-home-bluetooth/README.md && echo 'HACS mentioned in README' to confirm HACS instructions are present
findings: All verification checks pass. 22 existing tests still pass. Named the integration 'TCL Home Soundbar' to indicate it supports any TCL soundbar compatible with the TCL Home app via Bluetooth, not just one specific model.
